# Byte protocol fixture

`relay_state.py` is the unmodified public Byte helper from `elan6666/byte-skills@d194a20ad9725ea00208e04726f717a3364105d2`, SHA-256 `ed7b184db93749deadcd4cfdf75b646b7fc998f6a9970c6a60ef98a5fd0452f3`.

It is a test-only protocol snapshot, not an installed or forked product Skill. Tests create minimal invented owner/session/state files in disposable roots, never copy research state or read global credentials. Runtime integration requires an explicitly located installed helper with the checked digest.
